quest.title: Strange Stone Chronicle
quest.description: In order to find Puca's token, you once again visit the vein from before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Puca, why are you here again?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There shouldn't be any more monsters nearby, but who knows what other dangers there might be...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, you shouldn't go running off on your own!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: #I didn't run off, Paimon and {NICKNAME}... I'm just looking for my token...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You lost your token?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Yup... It should be somewhere around that place I usually pick rocks from...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... You might've dropped it when you got trapped there before.

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: *sniff* Yeah, you might be right... I was too scared to care about anything else at that time...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: It's still a little scary to think about, but my token's very important... I have to find it, I just have to...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Paimon thinks it'll be too dangerous if Puca goes there on her own. In that case...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, why don't we take a trip back there and help Puca find her token? Puca, just go home and wait for us!

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME} and Paimon! I'll be good and wait for you at home.

choices.text: I've been wanting to explore that place anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Puca, we're back! We found your token.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You give the token to Puca.

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Ohh, yes, this is the one! Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We also found something else while we were looking for your token...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's an ore we've never seen before. We thought it might be valuable, so we brought it back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If Paimon remembers correctly, you often pick up pretty stones around this area, right? Have you seen any stones like this before?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Let me see... It really is pretty! But it's not precious at all... it's just an ordinary stone...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: It's true that you won't find anything like this in other places, but they're everywhere in nearby ore veins!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw, so it's just an ordinary rock! Paimon thought it looked super valuable...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like we can't use it for anything else. Let's just find a place to dump it...

choices.text: But if you can't find the ore elsewhere...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, you mean we could make a fortune if we took it elsewhere and sold it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #You do have a point! People don't normally go mining in a Melusine village, which means they've probably never seen anything like this... Great thinking, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, let's take this stone to the Court of Fontaine and show the merchants!

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: If there's anything else you'd like to know about ores, come find me anytime...

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Though I don't run a gemstone workshop like my sister and don't know much about appraisals or processing...

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Compared to precious gems, I prefer collecting all kinds of unique rocks...

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: I guess you can say I know the local ore veins pretty well!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, gotcha!

choices.text: But if it's unique to this region...

talks.objective: Give the token you found to Puca
Take the strange ore to the Gem Merchant in the Court of Fontaine

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Welcome, welcome. Our store offers the most extensive selection of precious gems in the entire Court of Fontaine. We also have a wide range of craft goods on sale.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Anything catch your eye? If not, I would be delighted to meet any other demands!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We've got some mysterious ore here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup! Since you have such an extensive inventory, you should know its value, right?

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Oh? So you're here to trade ore?

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Then you've come to the right person! We offer some of the best and fairest prices in Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Let's see what you have here...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You show Chesil the strange ore you found earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Whoa... Even I've never seen anything like this before...

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: The unique sheen and smooth texture... Ooh, this is no doubt a rare variety!

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Pardon me for asking, but what exactly is this?

response.speaker: Chesil
response.text: Is that why you're here for an appraisal?

response.speaker: Chesil
response.text: It's such a shame you only brought one chunk of ore...

response.speaker: Chesil
response.text: If only we had a steady supply... We could forge accessories that would take Fontaine by storm.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Puca mentioned these stones were everywhere near the ore veins. Maybe we should ask her...)

choices.text: We actually have a lot more of this ore.

response.speaker: Chesil
response.text: Really? That's wonderful!

response.speaker: Chesil
response.text: Anyway, in addition to the ore you brought, I'm willing to purchase more ore from you to make a batch of new products.

response.speaker: Chesil
response.text: I'm willing to put down an advance payment to show my sincerity — as long as you bring more ore the next time you visit.

response.speaker: Chesil
response.text: What do you think? I'd say it's a pretty fair deal.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, Paimon thinks so too! It's a deal!

response.speaker: Chesil
response.text: Perfect! Here's your payment...

response.speaker: Chesil
response.text: I wonder how the accessories made from this ore will turn out... Haha, can't say I'm not looking forward to it!

response.speaker: Chesil
response.text: I'll be here, waiting for your good news.

choices.text: The source is a trade secret.

response.speaker: Chesil
response.text: Oh, naturally, of course...

response.speaker: Chesil
response.text: Though as long as you have a reliable way of getting them, it's fine.

choices.text: You can find them around Elynas.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Why did you just tell him?

response.speaker: Chesil
response.text: You got it from Elynas, huh? Yeah, people wouldn't normally go prospecting there...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, don't give it weird names!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! Did you just come up with that on the spot?

response.speaker: Chesil
response.text: What an impressive name! No wonder it looks so unique.

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Hey there, it's you again!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to know about ore? You can ask me anything!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Even though I might not have an answer...

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: There's lots of beautiful and sparkly stones in the ore veins nearby, but they're nowhere as good as real gemstones...

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: If I were better at finding real gemstones, maybe I could open my own gemstone workshop, just like Sluasi!

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Huh? I've never thought about that before... I only collect stones because they're pretty...

choices.text: I don't have any more questions.

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Hehe, thanks for coming to play with me!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: My token is really important... I have to find it...
